# Goal
kama lane (local model serving & endpoint health), round 32, attempt 1, WAVE 1 (build + first falsifiers) — PREPARED, NOT YET DISPATCHED. This spec was prepared by the kama L1 (round 32, attempt 1) under the accepted host mapping: the hyaku orchestrator dispatches prepared waves between rounds. Seats must not run until dispatched by the orchestrator.
Lane repo: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin (jj-colocated; git branch master). Work ONLY inside this repo. Never mutate the fleet repo, sibling lanes, lane jj state or the lane Git index; read-only git (log/show/diff/status) is fine, never add/commit/push. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path>. Never message agent://all.
Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in your report); install via `uv tool`/`npx`/an official binary in ~/.local/bin.
Pacman guard (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-20, after the mado r15 libinput incident): ALL pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide until the operator resolves the host-recovery L0 question; never run pacman.
# Background
Round 32 landed two instrument repairs, both committed with receipts: C1 = `.ufo/waves/round-32/count-c2r.py` (round-qualified `(round,row,class)` correction key + uniqueness precondition; receipts under `.ufo/waves/round-32/c1/`, `c2r/`); C2 = `tools/gate-registry-check.py` v2 (registry-row meaning: table-row presence, cell presence, non-empty exit map, cited-path existence; receipts under `.ufo/waves/round-32/c2/`). The round-31 closure (`corpus/lessons/round-31-verifier-spotcheck.md`) also routed defects NOT repaired in round 32: (1) the round-31 C1 counter's eligibility — a counted row must name a parameter and value the base request does not already carry, and the `ignored` class must exclude keys the chat session consumes; (2) KQ42 probe gating of graded meaning cells (criterion in `corpus/QUALITY.md`); (4) pin declared `bytes` and refuse working-tree pin edits. The round-32 lesson (`corpus/lessons/round-32.md`) adds: a pointer-sweep generalization and a committed-registry seat census. The round-31 pinned llama.cpp snapshot lives at `.ufo/waves/round-31/sources/llama.cpp-704366d/` (manifest `SNAPSHOT.json`); the lane-owned live fixture tool is `tools/kama-llamacpp-live.py` (b11755 binary, pinned 1.2 MB GGUF, unregistered loopback ports only, torn down in the run).
# Wave purpose
Attack the round-32 claims from every angle AND build the round-33 candidates (eligibility counter, KQ42 probe gating, pin bytes, response_format/json_schema → grammar transform per S192). Every item names what it attacks or builds. All evidence under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-32/w1/out/. Build items write proposals/fixtures/tools under their seat directory only; they never edit lane files in place — the L1 integrates after the wave returns.
